Helodrace.HelodGasDef.label: photochlorogen gas
Helodrace.HelodGasDef.description: A pale delayed-action choking agent cloud. Photochlorogen first irritates the airways, then may seem to fade during a latent period before pulmonary edema begins damaging the lungs. Gas masks and other tox-gas exposure immunity block it.

Helodrace.HelodGasDef.label: sweet gas
Helodrace.HelodGasDef.description: A yellow delayed blister agent cloud. Sweet gas dose does not naturally fall; if no dose change occurs for several hours, the exposure is considered cleared. Gas masks and tox-gas exposure immunity do not block it; if Odyssey is installed, vacuum resistance reduces exposure.

Helodrace.HelodGasDef.label: CS gas
Helodrace.HelodGasDef.description: A dense tear-agent cloud that causes immediate eye, skin, and respiratory irritation. Gas protection and toxic-environment resistance reduce exposure.

Helodrace.HelodGasDef.label: white phosphorus smoke
Helodrace.HelodGasDef.description: A dense, persistent cloud produced by burning white phosphorus. It obscures gunfire as effectively as an ordinary smoke screen and can ignite flammable things caught inside.
